correctness.rationale: Reduction v=u(1+H(1-u²)), Phi=u W_B with B∈[0,H] and H<=1/alpha<=1 gives Phi>=u>=0 for u>=0 and alpha>=1. For B=H exact P(z,y,t)=[2-z(1+W_H²)]/(1-z) on [0,1]^3; independent exact algebra reconstructs 46 monomials and all 729 rational degree-eight Bernstein coefficients >=1/8 (minimum index (1,8,8)), hence Phi²+u²<=2 by endpoint interpolation and energy-difference factorization. For alpha<1 derivative at u=1 has large-step limit (1-2/alpha)²>1 (alpha=0 direct), giving energy increase near equilibrium. At alpha=1 output can exceed one; no iterated result. The exact finite coefficient certificate and Bernstein convexity, not random tests, prove positivity on the whole cube.
